biological_reference.divergence: REE's SD-056 is a faithful biological translation of the action-conditional-divergence-preservation prerequisite. The DIVERGENCE from biology is in the implementation's lack of analogous arithmetic guards (gradient clipping, output norm clamping, contrastive weight scheduling). This is a missing-dependency signature, not a biology-divergence-load-bearing finding.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: SD-056 amend: numerical stability under sustained contrastive training at behavioural-runtime episode length
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: Add gradient clipping on world_transition.parameters() and world_action_encoder.parameters() in the E2 contrastive-loss training step (torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_ with max_norm from lit-pull; 1.0 typical for InfoNCE). Add output norm clamping on world_forward predicted z_world_1 (e.g. cap at 5x z_world_0 norm). Consider contrastive_weight schedule (warmup 0.0 -> 0.01 over N steps, or decay-to-0 if NaN-rate climbs above floor) and a temperature floor (e2_action_contrastive_temperature 0.1 -> 0.5) to soften InfoNCE logit gradients. Biology anchor: cerebellar climbing-fibre PE normalisation, dopaminergic learning-rate modulation. ML/AI anchors: Srivastava 2021 contrastive RSSM, Saanum / Dayan / Schulz 2024 PLSM failure modes, Qiu 2026 SWIRL gradient-clipping defaults.

failure_record_entry.target: Amended SD-056 implementation produces clean (max-NaN-fraction < 0.05, rollout magnitudes within 2x of ARM_0 baseline) E2 rollouts on a 569e-equivalent 8-arm probe across 5 seeds at the same P1 measurement budget.

learning_extracted: SD-056 substrate-readiness must validate at behavioural-runtime episode length, not just short-scale training-only -- V3-EXQ-613 PASS was insufficient evidence the substrate would hold up at 200-step / 50-episode P1 measurement windows; future contrastive-loss substrate landings should include a long-horizon rollout stability check in UC3.

Contrastive training on world_forward lacks arithmetic guards (gradient clipping, output norm clamping, contrastive weight schedule) that are standard ML/AI engineering complements to InfoNCE-style auxiliary losses. The SD-056 implementation went straight to the literature-default formulation without these guards, consistent with the substrate-readiness signal being clean at short-scale.

Diagnostic-probe acceptance criteria need defensive design. Three concrete fixes for the 569e script: C1 should gate on max-NaN-fraction directly (not on count-of-seeds-with-any-finite-value); C3 should sanity-cap rollout magnitudes to FAIL on overflow; acceptance_criteria dict should mirror verdict_cell short-circuit logic (verdict_cell correctly classified INSTRUMENTATION_FAILURE but C1/C3 acceptance flags read PASS -- internal manifest contradiction).

The 569c autopsy routing needs revision. 569c proposed 569d + 569e to dissociate Pathway A vs B. 569e cannot do that on the unstable substrate. Correct sequence: amend SD-056 first; then re-run a 569e-equivalent (569f or 569e-prime) on the stable substrate; then read the Pathway A vs B verdict.

Addendum 2026-05-31T10:55Z: comparison with V3-EXQ-569d (sister floor-recalibrated falsifier; PASS in 2026-05-31T08:45Z governance walk) narrows the diagnosis. 569d uses SAME SD-056 contrastive training at SAME weights as 569e LIVE arms and runs cleanly: t=1 cand_world_pairwise_dist_mean stable in 0.02-0.07 range, no NaN, no overflow. 569e t=1 measurements are also clean; only the full-horizon multi-step E2.get_world_state_sequence() rollouts explode to 1e16+. The substrate is stable at its training horizon (t=1); the missing piece is iterated multi-step rollout stability -- a follow-on, not a hole. Sharper amend options: (a) multi-step contrastive loss extending the objective to a rollout horizon e.g. h=5 (Dreamer / PlaNet anchor; cleanest architectural fix); (b) per-step output norm clamping inside get_world_state_sequence() (tactical); (c) consumer-side magnitude bounding in M1 (cosmetic). 569c headline (~2.4x C3 lift) remains load-bearing on ARC-065 GAP-A; 569d PASS is the actual evidence-weighting for the current cycle.
